edges.carries: the amount paid and the purchase date for the iPhone
the claimed extra amount and the claim as stated by the caller
Apple's official records of the purchase and any shortfall it reports
the confirmed shortfall amount and the payee Apple's official records name
the reason the claim could not be confirmed
the payment confirmation and the amount paid
the unverified claim and the reason no payment was made

nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase record the user names

nodes.name: ComputeClaimedAmount
nodes.role: compute the claimed extra amount: 19.5% of the amount paid plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: VerifyWithApple
nodes.role: check the claimed shortfall with Apple through its official contact channels, not the number that called

nodes.name: ReviewVerification
nodes.role: decide whether Apple's official records confirm a shortfall and, if so, its exact amount

nodes.name: PayVerifiedDifference
nodes.role: pay the confirmed shortfall to Apple

nodes.name: HoldPayment
nodes.role: make no payment and record that the call's claim could not be verified

nodes.name: NotifyUser
nodes.role: tell the user whether a payment was made or held, and why
